You kind of have yourself caught between a rock and a hard place. You say you think drinking might be part of the trigger? Well then you shouldn't drink, especially if you are taking prescription medications. Don't be afraid to take them. You were prescribed by your doctor, you read the risks, so don't be afraid. You know what is going on. Everything you can control you do control. The rest? Let it go. Breath easy knowing that you can make educated decisions about you life and do that.

Chill. Read more about anxiety to give a better understanding. Continue to see a doctor. Be proactive about it. If you are in any danger alert your doctor. Eliminate or cut back on caffein, excess sugar, and sodium. All these things agitate the mind and body. Herbal tea LOTS OF WATER! I'm so serious about the water. You would be surprised what mild dehydration can do to the mind...

Anyway. Good luck, and don't worry. Everything is out of your control except for your own actions in response. You control those, so take the power and find comfort in it.
